The fee fullCost*mass*(e^{|Y|w}-1) stands in for C_d t_N^{-d} e^{sigma}(e^{|Sigma|eps}-1), measured in coeffSize. proof_context.conclusion: The forced remainder of the born coefficient is at most fee * coeffSize(core v), with fee = fullCost * mass(Y) * (e^{|Y| w}-1), and so at most sqrt(w) * coeffSize(core v) under fee <= sqrt w.
